hero.subheadline: Use Graph Italia to turn your data, from a CSV or JSON file, into interactive charts. The intuitive interface makes navigation easy and keeps the platform accessible to everyone.

features.label: How does it work?
features.title: Turn your data into charts in a few steps
features.subtitle: From the data set to creating and publishing charts, Graph Italia supports you through the whole workflow.

items.title: Different chart styles
items.description: Pick the chart that best represents your data from a wide library. All Graph Italia charts are accessible and responsive.

items.title: Optimized upload
items.description: You can upload CSV or JSON files, or import them from other websites through a URL.

items.title: Continuous updates
items.description: Graph Italia keeps a history of remote data, such as data loaded from a URL, and refreshes it every 24 hours.

items.title: Simplified customization
items.description: Graph Italia offers several parameters to customize the layout of your charts in a simple and intuitive way.

items.title: Accessibility by design
items.description: All Graph Italia components follow the web accessibility guidelines.

items.title: Open Source
items.description: Released under the GNU GPL v3 license, Graph Italia was built to be adopted and integrated by other public bodies and organizations.

integration.label: Integration via API keys
integration.title: Simplified integration
integration.subtitle: Embed the charts created on Graph Italia in your website in three steps thanks to API keys.

steps.title: Create and configure
steps.body: Upload your data, then create and customize your charts and/or dashboards.

steps.title: Generate your API keys
steps.body: Once done, go to the project settings to generate a secure read-only API key: it lets you embed your work and show your data only where you decide.

steps.title: Embed the code in your website
steps.body: Go to the React component library and enter the API key and the identifier of your chart or dashboard: the component fetches the information and renders the chart automatically.

integration.codeNote: You can also embed using traditional <iframe> methods for non-React websites.

cta.title: Ready to shape your data?
cta.subtitle: Read our user guide and start creating your charts.
